_note: Inputs for the fundamentals prior (fundamentals.py). Every number has a source below. k, sd_fund, gamma, cap are measured or chosen in the backtest (see FUNDAMENTALS.md).
generic_ballot_source: Silver Bulletin generic ballot average (model version), 51.8-42.6 = D+9.2, 2026-10-27 (natesilver.net/p/generic-ballot-average-2026-nate-silver-bulletin-congress-polls). Nate Silver noted 2026-10-27 that the likely-voter version has narrowed to match the default.
pres_2024_note: Harris 48.3 vs Trump 49.8, two-party D-R, national.
skip_note: NE-senate: independent Osborn is on the ballot, so the presidential lean is not a valid baseline.
generic_shrink_note: Final House vote has landed below the late generic average in some wave years (2006 overstated by ~3) and near it in others (2018). 0.70 x D+9.2 = D+6.4, the low end of the D+6 to D+8 read, pulled toward the middle 2026-10-27.
k_note: Backtest pooled k=0.49 (2018 ~1.0, 2022 ~0). When the house swing is wave-sized (>= wave_threshold, as in 2018) k is the midpoint of k_pooled and k_wave = 0.75. Judgment informed by the analog years, not a fitted value.
sd_fund_note: Backtest: fundamentals alone miss by 10.5 (out of sample); regressing actual-minus-poll on fundamentals-minus-poll gives an optimal weight of about 0.11 (se 0.06). 12 gives 10-13% weight with 4.0-4.7 poll SDs.
